frontier.hypothesis: Every sanctioned axis for this residual is closed with a named GCC predicate rather than by saturation, and s28 closes the last two open cse inputs. The one-object family's cost law (s27), cse.c:1905 (the quantity gate), cse.c:7004 + mips.md:2901 (the bitfield gate), cse.c:7326 (libcall), cse.c:7599 (the call gate, priced at +2), sched.c:1738 (the ordering edge) and mips.h:2369 (the plain-symbol family) now cover the whole input space. What remains is a disposition question, not a probe.
frontier.mechanism: Restoring block 1's reload is instruction-free (a 1:1 nop-for-lbu swap), but every measured construct that restores it either costs +2 instructions (a fourth address materialisation; a CALL between the store and the read) or is inadmissible (a second declared pointer object -- the standing ban; a dead pointer round-trip -- dead arithmetic that fails cheat-checklist T1/T2/T6). The only zero-cost invalidator in 28 sessions is the round-trip, and its chassis is RA-FORECLOSED anyway.
